title: Clean Code
author: Robert C. Martin
comment: Essential reading for anyone wanting to write readable, elegant, and maintainable software. Changed how I structure functions!

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
comment: A sweeping, heartbreaking journey through Old Hollywood glamour, ambition, and the costs of protecting secrets. Utterly unputdownable.

title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
author: Stephen Chbosky
comment: A tender, emotional coming-of-age story that perfectly captures the feeling of feeling infinite and navigating mental health.

title: Verity
author: Colleen Hoover
comment: A dark, deeply unsettling psychological thriller. The twist at the end will leave you questioning everything you just read!
